# core/CLAUDE.md — Rust core rules

Applies to everything under `core/`. Build commands and the FFI three-file
lockstep are in the root `CLAUDE.md`; the full design is
`designs/spec/` (§5 the schemas, §6 the op table, §7 the architecture,
§7.10 this module map in the spec's words; its `README.md` is the index). The long form of
each entry below — why the seam fell where it did — is
`designs/adr/core-file-history.md` (the full history of every cut, with its
line counts, is archived; see its "Original" line); this file is what
governs a module now.

## Module map

- `lib.rs` — module declarations and re-exports only. No implementation code.
- `model.rs` — the spec §5.2 SHAPE: the project, its tracks, clips, sources,
  actions, markers and nests, with the serde defaults that say what an absent
  key means. The struct field names ARE the JSON keys. Nothing else lives here
  but `CanvasOutput` (`Canvas.output`, `sdr` or `hlg`, written only when
  `hlg`, format 23, spec §11 HD-2).
- `model_canvas.rs` — `CanvasBlending` (`Canvas.blending`, `encoded` or
  `linear`, written only when `linear`, format 24, spec §11 GR-18, HD-16),
  re-exported by `model.rs`; the recipe canvas carries it only when linear.
- `model_props.rs` — the schema's VOCABULARY: the per-clip property types
  (`VideoProps`, `AudioProps`, `Crop`, `Shadow`, `ColorAdjust`, `Chroma`,
  `Filter`, `Reflection`, `BlendMode`, `Compressor`, `Duck`) and their
  defaults, re-exported whole by `model.rs` so every `crate::model::X` path
  holds. **`BlendMode`'s, `ObscureKind`'s and `TrackMatte`'s declaration
  ORDER are shader discriminants** (`ProjectSnapshot.swift` and
  `TrackMatte.swift` derive the code from the case index, `Compositor.metal`
  compares against the same integers): append,
  never reorder. `Normal` is 0 with no `+1`, so a zeroed uniform block, an
  older recipe and a file with no `blend` key all render source-over.
- `model_text.rs` · `model_shape.rs` · `model_regions.rs` · `model_motion.rs`
  — the text, shape, region and motion vocabularies, each re-exported through
  `model_props.rs`. Text and shape are the two sources the model only
  DESCRIBES and the platform draws and measures: nothing in either file is
  ever a measured size. Regions (`Spotlight`, `ObscureRegion`, `SpotShape`,
  `MAX_OBSCURE`) share one coordinate frame — the centre as an offset in
  SOURCE pixels from the centre of the layer's cropped rect — which
  `edit_zoom.rs` writes out as an equation and nothing else restates. The
  one load-bearing declaration order in these four is `ObscureKind`'s
  (`model_regions.rs`), a shader discriminant like `BlendMode`'s above;
  elsewhere only the JSON spelling of every variant is, so a rename needs a migration step. The enums are closed:
  there is no neutral kind to fall back to.
- `model_words.rs` — the word-caption vocabulary (format version 9, road
  map 8's W1b): `TextCase`, `Word`, `WordMode`, `ActivePill` and
  `WordStyle` (whose `template()` is what `patch.rs`'s text template walks
  against), re-exported through `model_props.rs`; the FIELDS (`case`,
  `words`, `word_style`) close `TextProps`. Format version 12 (spec §11
  W-12) added three looks as KEYS, each off by default: `ActivePill.glide`,
  `WordStyle.active_fill` and `WordStyle.pause_dim` (0–1, range-checked in
  `props_check.rs`); `Word.end` is read by the recipe since then, not only
  by the pager. It also holds the two facts
  every writer of `text.words` shares, both `pub(crate)` and so named
  directly by their callers (a glob re-export cannot widen them):
  `token_count`, THE token rule (`split_whitespace` — the core is the one
  counter, spec §11 W-2), and `rebase_words`, the one saturating
  subtraction `trim_start`, `roll`, `add_transition`'s handle form and
  `split`'s second half make (W-3). Word times are clip-time POSITIONS: a
  negative start is legal, equal starts are legal, and `snap_animation`
  puts them on the grid after `check_text` has named what the caller sent.
- `model_graphic.rs` — the graphic vocabulary (format version 10, road
  map 10): `GraphicProps` (`name`, `width`, `height`, `in`, `length`,
  `props`) and `GRAPHIC_MIN_SIDE` / `GRAPHIC_MAX_SIDE` and the schema limits
  `GRAPHIC_MAX_PROPS` / `GRAPHIC_MAX_OPTIONS` / `GRAPHIC_MAX_STRING` /
  `GRAPHIC_TYPES` (`GRAPHIC_MAX_SIDE` restates the engine's `MAX_SIDE` and the
  header's `RC_GRAPHIC_MAX_SIDE`, and each other `GRAPHIC_<X>` the engine's
  `<X>`; `tests/graphic_ffi.rs`'s
  `one_max_side_in_the_engine_the_core_and_the_header` and its four
  `one_…_in_the_engine_and_the_core` tests pin them),
  re-exported through `model_props.rs`; the FIELD `Clip.graphic` stays in
  `model.rs`. And the `pub(crate)` checks every writer shares: `check_name`
  (G-3's `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$`, its clause `NAME_RULE` shared with
  `validate`), `check_side`, `check_schema` (the engine's sentences, COPIED —
  no module of the model may name the crate, G-2; a non-boolean `animate`
  on an entry is refused, G-41), `check_props` (by dotted
  path against the schema the op carries, shape only without one; a `null`
  is a removal and is never checked), `check_typed` (one value against its
  entry, answered normalised; `edit_action_graphic.rs` calls it under
  `graphic.props.<key>`), `check_count` (on the map about to be
  STORED). **A props map is changed only by `insert` and
  `shift_remove`**: under `preserve_order`, `Map::remove` is `swap_remove`,
  and `Project ==` cannot see the reorder.
- `model_look.rs` — the look vocabulary (spec §11 GR-7): `Look {kind, amount}`
  (the FIELD `VideoProps.look`, optional, written only when set) and the eight
  built-in looks' definitions as data — Color's four, Light's nine and a split
  tone each — which the recipe's `look` key carries whole, so retuning a look
  is a core change only. `actions.rs` turns a merged look with no valid `kind`
  into `null`, so an action's end can never drop the clip's video group.
  `kind: "lut"` names an imported LUT's media (`media`); `BUILT_IN` is the
  eight. `actions.rs`'s object discriminants (`kind`, `media`) switch at an
  action's end instead of interpolating.
- `model_grade.rs` — tier 2's grading vocabulary (format 16, spec §11 GR-11): `Wheels {lift,
  gamma, gain}`, each a `Wheel {x, y, master}`, the FIELD `VideoProps.wheels` written only when
  not neutral and each key only when not 0; `actions::wheels_json` writes all nine for the
  evaluator, the patch template and the recipe, as `color_json` does tone's. Format 17 (GR-12)
  adds `Curves {master, red, green, blue}`, each an optional list of 2–16 `[x, y]` points
  (`CurvePoint`), the FIELD `VideoProps.curves` written only when not the identity
  (`curve_is_identity`: every y = x, from x 0 to x 1); format 20 (GR-32) adds `hue_hue` and
  `hue_sat` (`[hue, value]` points, 0 ≤ hue < 360) and `CurveDomain` (each channel's identity,
  neutral and value range; `named()` and `named_mut()` give each channel's), a hue curve the
  identity when every value is its neutral; `actions_curves.rs`'s `curves_json` writes all
  six, an absent one as its domain's identity. Format 18 (GR-13) adds `Qualifier {hue,
  saturation, luma, invert}` (`HueRange {center, width, softness}` in degrees, `LevelRange
  {low, high, softness}` 0–1, a range `None` when off), the FIELD `VideoProps.qualifier`,
  written only when not neutral; it acts only on an adjustment clip. Format 21 (GR-35)
  adds `Qualifier.blur` (0…1, written only when above 0, after `invert`) and
  `QUALIFIER_BLUR_MAX`; `is_neutral` counts it, so a blur alone is kept. Re-exported whole
  by `model_props.rs`.
- `cube.rs` — the `.cube` reader (spec §11 GR-8): 3D only, size 2–65, the
  default domain; anything else refused by line and name. `ffi_cube.rs` — the
  four `rc_cube_*` exports. `lut.rs` — a LUT media's rules: placing one is
  refused, removing one clears the looks that name it (the clips stay) and
  the Camera Log of the media it converts, refusing first without
  `with_clips`; paste carries it by path. `Project::check_lut_reference` is
  the one check of a LUT named by media id, keyed by its field
  (`video.look.media`, `color.lut`).
- `model_media_color.rs` — camera log's vocabulary (format version 19,
  spec §11 GR-16): `LogCurve`, `CameraGamut` (`LogCurve::gamuts`, its
  default first) and `MediaColor` (`log`, `gamut`, `lut`, `detected`, and
  since format 22 `pq`, a `PqColor` — import's `file` reading, its
  `PeakSource`, the override `peak`, `PEAK_MIN`..`PEAK_MAX` — each written
  only when set; format 25 adds `canon_log2`, `canon_log3` and the gamut
  `cinema_gamut`, each Canon curve pairing with Cinema Gamut (its default)
  or BT.2020, spec §11 HD-17), re-exported by `model.rs` for `Media.color`.
  `media_color.rs` — its rules: `set_media_color` (a strict reader,
  `detected` and `pq` refused, its `peak` the override, "needs log or lut"
  judged on what the caller asked for, spec §11 HD-12),
  `check_media_color` (each refusal its own sentence; `add_media` and
  `validate` call it too; a `pq`-only colour stands), `without_camera_log`
  (what a LUT's removal or a paste leaves: the reading), `media_input` (the
  recipe layer's and the plan segment's `input`, with the effective `peak`)
  and `media_converted_by`.
- `dynamic_range.rs` — an HLG project's deliverables (spec §11 HD-5,
  HD-14): `DynamicRange` (`hlg`, `pq`, `sdr`), spelled `dynamic_range` both
  as an export override and as a recipe option; `deliverable` answers `None`
  for an audio row and for every row of an SDR project, else the picture:
  the three 10-bit rows carry `hlg` (the default), `pq` or `sdr`, every
  other video row writes the SDR version, and `hlg`/`pq` are refused in an
  SDR project and on a row that is not 10-bit, each in its own sentence.
- `av1_mp4.rs` · `ffi_av1.rs` — AV1 in MP4 (spec §11 CX-12, road map
  codec-export C1): `av1C` built from a full parse of the sequence header OBU,
  temporal delimiters stripped in place, and the `av01` brand put into `ftyp`
  (no `mp41` to replace is an error, never a file without `av01`); the three
  `rc_av1_*` exports. `leb128` is shared with `hdr10.rs`. The export table's
  `writer` field (`svt_av1` on `av1` only; `avf_preset` stays the ImageIO
  switch) and the `encoder_speed` override (`faster` | `balanced` | `smaller`,
  refused on any other row) are `export_table.rs`' and `export_overrides.rs`';
  `Container` is `export_container.rs`'.
- `hdr10.rs` · `ffi_hdr10.rs` — an HDR10 file's peak (spec §11 HD-6,
    3205 app/CLAUDE.md
    1014 core/CLAUDE.md
    4219 total

**Risk accepted:** Apple's VBR came in under the asked rate (72 kb/s for 128 k on a test
  tone), and libopus (+0.32 MB) is the fallback only if a quality or control gap shows up.

- **CX-8 — HDR** (default): the AV1 rows are 10-bit, with HLG or PQ tagged in both the
  bitstream (the sequence header's colour config) and the container (`colr` in MP4, `Colour`
  in WebM), plus HD-5's HDR10 mastering metadata (`mdcv`/`clli`, WebM's MasteringMetadata).
  They take `hevc_10bit`'s place in H-3's rules. VP9 Profile 2 HDR is a later phase of its
  own, WebM only, because VP9's bitstream carries no transfer function and the container must.
  **Risk accepted:** no player's HDR rendering of these files was measured.

- **CX-9 — The rate model keeps the bitrate semantics on every row** (default):
  1. `video_bitrate` is the single-pass VBR target (two passes would compose every frame
     twice);
  2. the Quality tiers apply HEVC's 0.6 factor to AV1 and VP9, and "Format default" is HEVC's
     0.07 bits per pixel per frame;
  3. the efficiency goes to the picture, not the file size, because the owner wants quality
     (2026-10-27): SVT 6 measured +2.8 to +4.8 VMAF over HEVC at HEVC's rate;
  4. **risk accepted:** a rate is a target, and single-pass SVT-AV1 undershot it by 14–22 % on
     5 s clips (libvpx overshot by 5–7 %). C1 re-measures on a full-length export. *Result
     (C1):* on the owner's 55 s 1080p30 clip single-pass VBR at Balanced came in at
     0.667–0.670 of the target in six runs, at "Format default" and at High
     (`designs/codec-export.md`, C1); the owner then chose capped constant quality for the
     AV1 rows, CX-13, which replaces (1) and this item there.

- **CX-10 — On an M1 or M2 the AV1 export still works, but Frame Job cannot preview or
  re-import that file** (default): those Macs have no AV1 decoder, and #216's refusal stands.
  The user guide says so (C1), and playback is a manual check on an M3 or later. **Risk
  accepted:** a user on an M1/M2 exports a file they cannot watch in Frame Job or QuickTime.

- **CX-11 — The working arrangement** (default): the road map is built in the `codecs`
  worktree, each phase gated and merged on its own. C0 adds no export row and no format bump:
  it records these decisions, opens the road map and builds and links the two libraries.

- **CX-12 — C1's shape: AV1 in MP4 at 8 bits** (default, recorded in C1 before its code):
  1. **The row.** `av1`, "AV1 (MP4)", after `hevc_10bit` in the table: MP4, codec `av1`, video
     with AAC audio, no alpha, even-sized as every AVFoundation row but `prores_4444` (G-33).
     Its `avf_preset` is `AVAssetExportPresetPassthrough`, a record only, because
     AVFoundation still writes the container; a new field, `writer` (`svt_av1`), names the
     encoder route, so `avf_preset: null` keeps meaning the ImageIO writer and no other row
     changes.
  2. **The speed.** `encoder_speed` is `faster`, `balanced` (the default) or `smaller` — SVT-AV1
     preset 8, 6 or 4 (CX-2) — and is refused on a row without encoder speeds, naming the key.
     The sheet's Speed row sits under Format (after Dynamic Range when that is shown); on
     another row it is disabled and shows the last choice, as Quality does, and the choice is
     remembered with the rest of the sheet (`ExportChoice`).
  3. **Keyframes.** A closed GOP (`intra_refresh_type` = `SVT_AV1_KF_REFRESH`), a keyframe at
     least every 2 s (`intra_period_length` = ⌊2·fps⌋ − 1). The sync samples are the
     passthrough `AVAssetWriter`'s own, read from the bitstream: C1 measured that marking every
     sample `NotSync` left the file's sync samples at exactly its KEY_FRAMEs, so the pump
     writes no sync attachment, and `av1_export_proof.py` A5's match of each key-flagged
     packet to a shown KEY_FRAME, both ways, is the guard. The `SVT_AV1_KF_REFRESH` line is
     live only under CX-13's capped CRF: SVT-AV1 v4.2.0 forces KF refresh under single-pass
     VBR (`lap_rc`), and under CRF its FWDKF refresh writes each 2 s refresh as a hidden
     INTRA_ONLY frame (`frame_type` 2, `show_frame` 0, shown later by `show_existing_frame`)
     after one KEY_FRAME, which A5 refuses.
  4. **The container bytes are the core's.** The `av1C` record (built from SVT's sequence
     header OBU), the stripping of temporal delimiters from every packet and the rewrite of
     the written file's `ftyp` to carry `av01` are decided in the core (CX-6's container-bytes
     precedent; `rc_av1_*`). A written file whose `ftyp` cannot take `av01` fails the export.
  5. **The frames.** The compositor's 64RGBAHalf frames are converted on the GPU to BT.709
     video-range I420 (chroma the mean of each 2×2 block); when the export size is not the
     canvas, `MPSImageLanczosScale` scales first, fit or fill per G-33 (c), with black bars.
  6. **SVT-AV1's log** goes through `svt_av1_set_log_callback`: info and debug are dropped,
     warnings and errors become `NSLog("SVT-AV1: …")`.
  7. **HDR projects.** In an HLG project the `av1` row writes the SDR version, by HD-14's
     existing rule for an SDR row; 10-bit and HDR AV1 are C2's (CX-8).

- **CX-13 — AV1's rate is a soft cap: capped constant quality, quality first** (owner,
  2026-10-27, "Capped constant quality", chosen after C1 measured single-pass VBR at
  0.667–0.670 of its target on a 55 s 1080p clip; then 2026-10-28, "Quality first, soft
  cap"; amends CX-9 (1) and (4) for the AV1 rows, CX-9 (2) and (3) standing):
  1. **The mode.** SVT-AV1 runs capped CRF: `rate_control_mode` 0 with `aq_mode` 2 (what its
     own `--crf` sets), `qp` the CRF, and `max_bit_rate` the cap — the mode SVT-AV1 v4.2.0's
     `EbSvtAv1Enc.h` documents for `max_bit_rate` and `mbr_over_shoot_pct` ("Capped CRF") and
     its `enc_settings.c` refuses outside rate-control mode 0. `mbr_over_shoot_pct` is SVT's
     own default, 50 (`EbSvtAv1Enc.h` "Default is 50", `enc_settings.c`, `Docs/Parameters.md`),
     so the requested rate is a cap the encoder aims under that hard footage may exceed: at
     (3)'s CRFs on the spike's clips the largest whole-file average was **1.254 × the cap**
     (gh5, 25 fps, Faster at Format default; 14 of 45 files over 1 ×, all of them gh5 but one
     real8 at 1.022 ×), with every file at or above HEVC's VMAF (the least margin +0.035).
     **The tolerance:** `av1_export_proof.py` R1 and R2 hold each file of the owner's clip to
     at most 1.30 × the cap (raised from 1.25 × at integration, above the measured 1.254 ×) and to a VMAF at or above `hevc`'s. **Declined (owner, 2026-10-28):
     a strict cap.** At 12 % overshoot every spike file stayed at or under 0.990 × the cap, but
     the cap then lowers the picture while the file is far under it (SVT holds keyframes and
     base-layer frames to a share of each 60-frame window), and the owner's clip at Faster,
     Format default, plateaued under HEVC's 95.469:

     | Faster, Format default, owner's clip | 12 % overshoot | 50 % overshoot |
     |---|---|---|
     | CRF 24 | 95.055 (0.645 × the cap) | 95.583 (0.729 ×) |
     | CRF 20 | 95.184 (0.703 ×) | 95.919 (0.844 ×) |
     | CRF 16 | 95.348 (0.735 ×) | — |

     (25 % and 20 % held gh5 to 1.03 × and 0.999 × at the first CRFs; at 10 % the cap
     dropped gh5 at Faster's Medium 0.02–0.08 VMAF under HEVC.)
  2. **The cap** is the rate the row resolves today: `video_bitrate` when asked (the Quality
     popup's tier rate, HEVC's 0.6 factor, CX-9 (2)), else HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel per
     frame ("Format default"), clamped to SVT's 100,000 kb/s.
  3. **The CRF matches or beats HEVC at HEVC's own rate, so a Quality tier moves it.** The
     encoder sees only the cap, so the CRF is a function of the cap's bits per pixel per frame
     (cap ÷ (width × height × fps)) and the speed: linear between the calibrated points below,
     rounded down (a lower CRF is the better picture), and the end point's CRF beyond either
     end. Each point is the lower of two calibrations, each the highest CRF on its grid at
     which SVT-AV1 at that preset reached VMAF ≥ HEVC's at the point's rate (ffmpeg's libvmaf;
     `tools/proof/work/codec-spike/crf.py`, `crf_owner.py`, `crf.jsonl`): the spike's three
     8-bit 1080p clips (gh5, promo, real8), SVT-AV1's own encoder against VideoToolbox HEVC
     through ffmpeg, CRF 18–46 in steps of 2; and the owner's 55 s 1080p30 IMG_0018.MOV
     through Frame Job itself, its `av1` export (a copy of the tree reading the CRF from a
     file) against its `hevc` export, both scored against its `prores_422` export, CRF 12–44
     on a grid of 2 to 8. The second was added when `av1_export_proof.py` R1 and R2 found the
     first's CRFs 0.6–1.9 VMAF under the app's HEVC on that clip: the spike's command-line
     encodes of decoded frames score lower than the app's own, by 1.1 VMAF for SVT-AV1 at one
     CRF and 1.6 for HEVC at one rate on that clip, so the first did not transfer.

     | bits per pixel per frame (the 1080p30 rate) | Faster (8) | Balanced (6) | Smaller file (4) |
     |---|---|---|---|
     | 0.0386 (Low, 2.4 Mb/s) | 40 | 36 | 36 |
     | 0.0579 (Medium, 3.6 Mb/s) | 28 | 30 | 30 |
     | 0.0700 (Format default, 4.35 Mb/s) | 24 | 26 | 26 |
     | 0.0772 (High, 4.8 Mb/s) | 22 | 24 | 24 |
     | 0.1157 (Maximum, 7.2 Mb/s) | 14 | 16 | 16 |

     The owner's clip binds every point but Faster's Medium, which the spike's promo graphic
     binds (its VMAF saturates near 97.7, so its margins are hundredths of a point), and
     Faster's Low, where both give 40. At (1)'s 50 % the owner's clip held it under the real
     cap (`--rate` on Release, 2026-10-28): Format default 95.570 / 95.632 / 95.506 and High
     95.856 / 96.067 / 95.951 (Faster / Balanced / Smaller file) against `hevc`'s 95.469 and
     95.777, every file 0.48–0.73 × the cap.
  4. **What the user is told.** The guide, the MCP page, the sheet's tier titles and footnote
     ("usually ≤ …") and `export`'s `video_bitrate` description say the rate is a soft cap the
     file usually stays under, and one sentence names the measured overshoot (about 1.25 ×).
     **Risk accepted:** a file's size is no longer predictable from its rate and can exceed
     it; the calibration is four clips at 1080p (other sizes are placed by bits per pixel
     alone), one of them the binding one, so other footage can land a little under HEVC; and
     the owner clip's grid is coarse (Balanced and Smaller file at Low: 36 passed, 44 did not).

  0.667–0.670 of its target on a 55 s 1080p clip; then 2026-10-28, "Quality first, soft
  cap"; amends CX-9 (1) and (4) for the AV1 rows, CX-9 (2) and (3) standing):
  1. **The mode.** SVT-AV1 runs capped CRF: `rate_control_mode` 0 with `aq_mode` 2 (what its
     own `--crf` sets), `qp` the CRF, and `max_bit_rate` the cap — the mode SVT-AV1 v4.2.0's
     `EbSvtAv1Enc.h` documents for `max_bit_rate` and `mbr_over_shoot_pct` ("Capped CRF") and
     its `enc_settings.c` refuses outside rate-control mode 0. `mbr_over_shoot_pct` is SVT's
     own default, 50 (`EbSvtAv1Enc.h` "Default is 50", `enc_settings.c`, `Docs/Parameters.md`),
     so the requested rate is a cap the encoder aims under that hard footage may exceed: at
     (3)'s CRFs on the spike's clips the largest whole-file average was **1.254 × the cap**
     (gh5, 25 fps, Faster at Format default; 14 of 45 files over 1 ×, all of them gh5 but one
     real8 at 1.022 ×), with every file at or above HEVC's VMAF (the least margin +0.035).
     **The tolerance:** `av1_export_proof.py` R1 and R2 hold each file of the owner's clip to
     at most 1.30 × the cap (raised from 1.25 × at integration, above the measured 1.254 ×) and to a VMAF at or above `hevc`'s. **Declined (owner, 2026-10-28):
     a strict cap.** At 12 % overshoot every spike file stayed at or under 0.990 × the cap, but
     the cap then lowers the picture while the file is far under it (SVT holds keyframes and
     base-layer frames to a share of each 60-frame window), and the owner's clip at Faster,
     Format default, plateaued under HEVC's 95.469:

     | Faster, Format default, owner's clip | 12 % overshoot | 50 % overshoot |
     |---|---|---|
     | CRF 24 | 95.055 (0.645 × the cap) | 95.583 (0.729 ×) |
     | CRF 20 | 95.184 (0.703 ×) | 95.919 (0.844 ×) |
     | CRF 16 | 95.348 (0.735 ×) | — |

     (25 % and 20 % held gh5 to 1.03 × and 0.999 × at the first CRFs; at 10 % the cap
     dropped gh5 at Faster's Medium 0.02–0.08 VMAF under HEVC.)
  2. **The cap** is the rate the row resolves today: `video_bitrate` when asked (the Quality
     popup's tier rate, HEVC's 0.6 factor, CX-9 (2)), else HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel per
     frame ("Format default"), clamped to SVT's 100,000 kb/s.
  3. **The CRF matches or beats HEVC at HEVC's own rate, so a Quality tier moves it.** The
     encoder sees only the cap, so the CRF is a function of the cap's bits per pixel per frame
     (cap ÷ (width × height × fps)) and the speed: linear between the calibrated points below,
     rounded down (a lower CRF is the better picture), and the end point's CRF beyond either
     end. Each point is the lower of two calibrations, each the highest CRF on its grid at
     which SVT-AV1 at that preset reached VMAF ≥ HEVC's at the point's rate (ffmpeg's libvmaf;
     `tools/proof/work/codec-spike/crf.py`, `crf_owner.py`, `crf.jsonl`): the spike's three
     8-bit 1080p clips (gh5, promo, real8), SVT-AV1's own encoder against VideoToolbox HEVC
     through ffmpeg, CRF 18–46 in steps of 2; and the owner's 55 s 1080p30 IMG_0018.MOV
     through Frame Job itself, its `av1` export (a copy of the tree reading the CRF from a
     file) against its `hevc` export, both scored against its `prores_422` export, CRF 12–44
     on a grid of 2 to 8. The second was added when `av1_export_proof.py` R1 and R2 found the
     first's CRFs 0.6–1.9 VMAF under the app's HEVC on that clip: the spike's command-line
     encodes of decoded frames score lower than the app's own, by 1.1 VMAF for SVT-AV1 at one
     CRF and 1.6 for HEVC at one rate on that clip, so the first did not transfer.

     | bits per pixel per frame (the 1080p30 rate) | Faster (8) | Balanced (6) | Smaller file (4) |
     |---|---|---|---|
     | 0.0386 (Low, 2.4 Mb/s) | 40 | 36 | 36 |
     | 0.0579 (Medium, 3.6 Mb/s) | 28 | 30 | 30 |
     | 0.0700 (Format default, 4.35 Mb/s) | 24 | 26 | 26 |
     | 0.0772 (High, 4.8 Mb/s) | 22 | 24 | 24 |
     | 0.1157 (Maximum, 7.2 Mb/s) | 14 | 16 | 16 |

     The owner's clip binds every point but Faster's Medium, which the spike's promo graphic
     binds (its VMAF saturates near 97.7, so its margins are hundredths of a point), and
     Faster's Low, where both give 40. At (1)'s 50 % the owner's clip held it under the real
     cap (`--rate` on Release, 2026-10-28): Format default 95.570 / 95.632 / 95.506 and High
     95.856 / 96.067 / 95.951 (Faster / Balanced / Smaller file) against `hevc`'s 95.469 and
     95.777, every file 0.48–0.73 × the cap.
  4. **What the user is told.** The guide, the MCP page, the sheet's tier titles and footnote
     ("usually ≤ …") and `export`'s `video_bitrate` description say the rate is a soft cap the
     file usually stays under, and one sentence names the measured overshoot (about 1.25 ×).
     **Risk accepted:** a file's size is no longer predictable from its rate and can exceed
     it; the calibration is four clips at 1080p (other sizes are placed by bits per pixel
     alone), one of them the binding one, so other footage can land a little under HEVC; and
     the owner clip's grid is coarse (Balanced and Smaller file at Low: 36 passed, 44 did not).

  the same light capture — within 40 levels is enabled, more than 60 lighter
  is disabled.
* R1, R2 — only with `--rate` (CX-13's soft-capped CRF): the owner's full-length
  clip `tools/proof/media/owner-sync/IMG_0018.MOV` (1920 × 1080, 30 fps,
  55.27 s) exported once as `prores_422` (the reference), then, R1 at "Format
  default" (no `video_bitrate`: the cap is HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel per
  frame) and R2 at the sheet's High tier (`video_bitrate` 0.129 × 0.6 to the
  nearest 100 kbps, asked of both), as `hevc` and as `av1` at each speed:
  each `av1` file's video bit rate (ffprobe, the whole file's average) is at
  most 1.25 × the cap (CX-13's soft cap) and its VMAF against the reference
  (ffmpeg's libvmaf, both as 8-bit 4:2:0) is at or above the `hevc` file's.
  Prints each rate, its share of the cap, each VMAF and each encode's frames
  per second. A missing fixture skips R by name; a libvmaf that cannot run is
  a FAIL.

`--mutant NAME` builds a copy of the tree (`tree_copy.make_copy`; `core/` made
the copy's own for a core mutant, `hevc_alpha_proof.own_core`) with each of the
mutant's anchors replaced (each found exactly once), builds its app
(`tree_copy.build_app`), runs every row but R on it (and, for a core mutant,
its `cargo test` file in the copy's core), and exits 1 when exactly the named
rows fail (caught), 0 when none of them does (survived), 3 when they fail
with others beside them, and 2 when the control could not be performed (a
copy, an anchor, a build or a launch).

  td-kept                    the core's strip keeps every temporal delimiter:
                             A4 and `cargo test --test av1_mp4`
  brand-unpatched            the finished file is never branded: A2
  open-gop                   `SVT_AV1_FWDKF_REFRESH` (an open GOP): A5 (hidden
                             INTRA_ONLY frames, one key) and Z1 (SVT-AV1's warning
                             that it set hierarchical levels to 4 for it)
  speed-ignored              SVT's preset fixed at 6: A7
  encode-ignores-cancel      every `isStopping()` in `ExportEncodePump` removed: A6
  speed-on-any-row           the core takes `encoder_speed` on any row: A7 and
                             `cargo test --test export_av1`

  colour-untagged-container  the format description's colour extensions

An instrument that cannot run is a FAIL, never an exit.

def check(ident, ok, detail):

# ---- reading the files (ffprobe, ffmpeg, the MP4's bytes) ------------------------

def run(argv, seconds=600):
    return bounded.run([str(a) for a in argv], seconds)


def streams(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries",
               "stream=codec_type,codec_name,codec_tag_string,profile,pix_fmt,width,height,"
               "duration,bit_rate,nb_frames,time_base", "-of", "json", path])
    return json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}").get("streams", [])


def video_stream(path):
    return next((s for s in streams(path) if s.get("codec_type") == "video"), {})


def brands(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format_tags=compatible_brands",
               "-of", "json", path])
    return (json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}").get("format", {}).get("tags", {})
            .get("compatible_brands", ""))


def decoded_frames(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
               "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "csv=p=0", path])
    try:
        return int(ran["stdout"].strip().split(",")[0])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def decode_errors(path):
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", path, "-f", "null", "-"])
    return ran["rc"], [line for line in ran["stderr"].splitlines() if line.strip()]


def packets(path):
    """ffprobe's video packets: [(pts seconds, key)]."""
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",
               "packet=pts_time,flags", "-of", "csv=p=0", path])
    out = []
    for line in ran["stdout"].splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split(",")
        if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] not in ("", "N/A"):
            out.append((float(parts[0]), "K" in parts[1]))
    return out


def trace(path):
    """`trace_headers` over the video: (header fields before the first packet,
    [{"key": bool, "fields": [(name, value)]}] per packet)."""
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "trace", "-i", path, "-map", "0:v:0", "-c",
               "copy", "-bsf:v", "trace_headers", "-f", "null", "-"])
    head, out = [], []
    for line in ran["stderr"].splitlines():
        if "[trace_headers" not in line or "] " not in line:
            continue
        body = line.split("] ", 1)[1]
        started = re.match(r"Packet: \d+ bytes, (key frame, )?pts", body)
        if started:
            out.append({"key": bool(started.group(1)), "fields": []})
            continue
        field = re.match(r"\d+\s+(\S+)\s+[01]+ = (-?\d+)$", body.strip())
        if field:
            (out[-1]["fields"] if out else head).append((field.group(1), int(field.group(2))))
    return head, out


def shows_key(fields):
    """Whether a packet's shown frame is a KEY_FRAME: a frame header with
    `frame_type` 0 and `show_frame` 1."""
    frame_type = None
    for name, value in fields:
        if name == "show_existing_frame":
            frame_type = None
        elif name == "frame_type":
            frame_type = value
        elif name == "show_frame" and value == 1 and frame_type == 0:
            return True
    return False


def hidden_intra(fields):
    """Whether a packet holds an intra frame that is not shown — a KEY_FRAME or an
    INTRA_ONLY frame (`frame_type` 0 or 2) with `show_frame` 0, shown later by
    `show_existing_frame`: an open GOP's forward keyframe, which SVT-AV1 v4.2.0
    writes as a hidden INTRA_ONLY frame."""
    frame_type = None
    for name, value in fields:
        if name == "show_existing_frame":
            frame_type = None
        elif name == "frame_type":
            frame_type = value
        elif name == "show_frame" and value == 0 and frame_type in (0, 2):
            return True
    return False


def y_plane(path, width, height, index=0):
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-vf",
                          f"select=eq(n\\,{index})", "-frames:v", "1", "-f", "rawvideo",
                          "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-"], capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    data = ran.stdout
    return data[:width * height] if len(data) >= width * height else None


def boxes(data, start, end):
    at = start
    while at + 8 <= end:
        size, kind = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[at:at + 8])
        header = 8
        if size == 1:
            size, header = struct.unpack(">Q", data[at + 8:at + 16])[0], 16
        elif size == 0:
            size = end - at
        if size < header or at + size > end:
            return
        yield kind.decode("latin-1"), at + header, at + size
        at += size


def colr_of(path):
    """The `av01` sample entry's `colr` box: (type, primaries, transfer, matrix,
    full_range) or None, read from the file's bytes."""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()

    def find(start, end, chain):
        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, start, end):
            if kind != chain[0]:
                continue
            if len(chain) == 1:
                return body, stop
            if kind == "stsd":
                body += 8            # version, flags, entry count
            found = find(body, stop, chain[1:])
            if found:
                return found
        return None

    for _, trak, trak_end in [b for b in boxes(data, 0, len(data)) if b[0] == "moov"]:
        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, trak, trak_end):
            if kind != "trak":
                continue
            entry = find(body, stop, ["mdia", "minf", "stbl", "stsd", "av01"])
            if not entry:
                continue
            # VisualSampleEntry: 6 reserved + 2 index + 16 pre_defined/reserved + 4 size
            # + 8 resolution + 4 reserved + 2 frame count + 32 compressor + 2 depth + 2 -1.
            for child, cbody, cstop in boxes(data, entry[0] + 78, entry[1]):
                if child == "colr" and data[cbody:cbody + 4] == b"nclx":
                    p, t, m = struct.unpack(">HHH", data[cbody + 4:cbody + 10])
                    return ("nclx", p, t, m, data[cbody + 10] >> 7)
            return None
    return None


# ---- the instance ----------------------------------------------------------------

class Instance:
    def __init__(self, label, app, arguments=(), env=None, home=False):
        self.label = label
        self.dir = WORK / label
        tree_copy.remove_tree(str(self.dir))
        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.log = self.dir / "instance.log"
        if home:
            (self.dir / "home").mkdir()
            env = {**(env or {}), "CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(self.dir / "home")}
        self.launched = mcp.launch(str(proof_app.executable(app)), list(arguments),
                                   env=bounded.child_env(env or {}), log_path=str(self.log),
                                   timeout=900)
        self.client = self.launched.client

    def stop(self):
        self.launched.stop()
        mcp.remove_scratch(self.launched.socket_path)

    def complaints(self):
        try:
            lines = self.log.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
        except OSError:
            return ["the log could not be read"]
        return [line.strip() for line in lines
                if "Frame Job: " in line or "Svt[" in line or "SVT-AV1: " in line]


class Doc:
    def __init__(self, instance, name, width=640, height=360):
        self.client = instance.client
        self.path = str(instance.dir / f"{name}.framejob")
        self.client.call("new_project", path=self.path)
        try:
            self.call("set_canvas", width=width, height=height, fps=30)
        except mcp.ToolError as error:
            if "made no change" not in str(error):    # a new project is 1920 × 1080 at 30
                raise

    def call(self, tool, **arguments):
        return self.client.call_with(tool, {"project": self.path, **arguments})

    def track(self):
        return self.call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][0]["id"]

    def media(self, path):
        return self.call("import_media", path=str(path))["media"]

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.call("close_project", discard=True)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass


def av_doc(instance, name):
    """AV.mov from 0 under a two-second text clip on a track of its own."""
    doc = Doc(instance, name)
    media = doc.media(AV)
    doc.call("add_clip", track=doc.track(), media=media, at=0)
    doc.call("add_track", name="Titles")
    titles = doc.call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][-1]["id"]
    doc.call("add_text_clip", track=titles, at=0, duration=2 * SEC, text={"content": "AV1"})
    return doc


def export(doc, path, **arguments):
    Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return doc.client.export_with({"project": doc.path, "path": str(path), **arguments})


def refusal(doc, path, **arguments):
    Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    try:
        answer = doc.client.call_with("export", {"project": doc.path, "path": str(path),
                                                 **arguments})
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        return str(error)
    if isinstance(answer, dict) and "export_id" in answer:
        try:
            doc.client.wait_export(answer["export_id"], seconds=300)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass
    return None


# ---- the rows --------------------------------------------------------------------

def rows_a1_a5(doc, out):
    a1 = out / "a1.mp4"
    try:
        done = export(doc, a1, preset="av1")
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        for ident in ("A1", "A2", "A3a", "A3b", "A4", "A5"):
            check(ident, False, f"A1's export failed: {error}")
        return
    got = streams(a1)
    video = next((s for s in got if s.get("codec_type") == "video"), {})
    audio = next((s for s in got if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"), {})
    seen = (video.get("codec_name"), video.get("codec_tag_string"), video.get("profile"),
            video.get("pix_fmt"), video.get("width"), video.get("height"),
            audio.get("codec_name"), audio.get("codec_tag_string"))
    want = ("av1", "av01", "Main", "yuv420p", 640, 360, "aac", "mp4a")
    length = float(video.get("duration") or 0)
    check("A1", done.get("status") == "done" and seen == want and abs(length - 5) <= 1 / 30,
          f"status {done.get('status')}, {done.get('bytes')} bytes; read {seen} (want {want}); "
          f"video {length:.3f} s")
    found = brands(a1)
    check("A2", "av01" in found, f"compatible brands {found!r}")

    head, per_packet = trace(a1)
    every = head + [f for p in per_packet for f in p["fields"]]
    names = ("color_description_present_flag", "color_primaries", "transfer_characteristics",
             "matrix_coefficients", "color_range")
    values = {n: sorted({v for k, v in every if k == n}) for n in names}
    check("A3a", values == {names[0]: [1], names[1]: [1], names[2]: [1], names[3]: [1],
                            names[4]: [0]},
          f"the sequence headers' {values}")
    colr = colr_of(a1)
    check("A3b", colr == ("nclx", 1, 1, 1, 0), f"the av01 entry's colr {colr}")

    rc, errors = decode_errors(a1)
    count = decoded_frames(a1)
    tds = [v for k, v in every if k == "obu_type" and v == 2]
    check("A4", rc == 0 and not errors and count == FRAMES and not tds,
          f"ffmpeg rc {rc}, {len(errors)} error lines {errors[:2]}; {count} frames decoded "
          f"(want {FRAMES}); {len(tds)} temporal delimiters in {len(per_packet)} packets")

    listed = packets(a1)
    keys = [t for t, k in listed if k]
    gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(keys, keys[1:])] + ([length - keys[-1]] if keys else [])
    bound = math.ceil(length / 2) + 1
    mismatched = [i for i, p in enumerate(per_packet) if p["key"] != shows_key(p["fields"])]
    hidden = [i for i, p in enumerate(per_packet) if hidden_intra(p["fields"])]
    ok = (len(listed) == len(per_packet) and listed and listed[0][1] and gaps
          and max(gaps) <= 2.0 + 1e-6 and len(keys) <= bound and len(keys) < len(listed)
          and not mismatched and not hidden)
    check("A5", ok, f"{len(listed)} packets ({len(per_packet)} traced), keys at {keys}; "
          f"longest K-to-K gap {max(gaps) if gaps else None} s (≤ 2.0); {len(keys)} keys "
          f"(≤ {bound}), {len(listed) - len(keys)} not; K flag ≠ shown KEY_FRAME at "
          f"{mismatched[:6]}; hidden intra frames at {hidden[:6]}")


def row_a6(instance, out):
    path = out / "a6.mp4"
    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    detail = ""
    ok = False
    doc = None
    try:
        doc = Doc(instance, "a6", 1920, 1080)
        media = doc.media(AV)
        track = doc.track()
        for k in range(24):
            doc.call("add_clip", track=track, media=media, at=k * 5 * SEC)
        clips = [c["id"] for c in doc.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"]]
        doc.call("set_video", clips=clips, patch={"scale": 3.0})
        length = doc.call("get_project")["project"]
        started = doc.client.call_with("export", {"project": doc.path, "path": str(path),
                                                  "preset": "av1", "encoder_speed": "balanced"})
        job = started["export_id"]
        # The export measures its sound first (the "Measuring loudness…" phase, whose
        # progress is the bar's first share, and the bar is put at that share's end when
        # the writer starts); the cancel must land while SVT-AV1 encodes, so it waits for
        # the phase to end and then for the bar to move past where the writer started it.
        progress, status, measured, floor = 0, {}, None, None
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            status = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
            progress = status.get("progress") or 0
            if status.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
                break
            if status.get("phase"):
                measured = max(measured or 0, progress)
            elif status.get("status") == "running" and measured is not None:
                if floor is None:
                    floor = progress
                elif progress > floor:
                    break
            time.sleep(0.05)
        if status.get("status") != "running":
            detail = f"never running past the measurement with progress above it: {status}"
        else:
            asked = time.monotonic()
            doc.client.call("cancel_export", export_id=job)
            final = {}
            while time.monotonic() - asked < 600:
                final = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
                if final.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
                    break
                time.sleep(0.05)
            took = time.monotonic() - asked
            exists = path.exists()
            ok = final.get("status") == "cancelled" and took <= CANCEL_BOUND and not exists
            detail = (f"cancelled while encoding, at progress {progress:.4f} (the measurement "
                      f"ended at {measured}, the writer started at {floor}); status {final.get('status')!r} "
                      f"{took:.2f} s after cancel_export (≤ {CANCEL_BOUND}); a file at the "
                      f"path: {exists}; the project {len(clips)} clips, "
                      f"{length['canvas']['width']} × {length['canvas']['height']}")
    except (mcp.ToolError, KeyError) as error:
        detail = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
    finally:
        if doc is not None:
            doc.close()
    check("A6", ok, detail)


def row_a7(doc, out, a1_bytes):
    sizes, lines, ok = {}, [], True
    for speed in ("faster", "balanced", "smaller"):
        path = out / f"a7-{speed}.mp4"
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            done = export(doc, path, preset="av1", encoder_speed=speed)
        except mcp.ToolError as error:
            ok = False
            lines.append(f"{speed}: {error}")
            continue
        sizes[speed] = done.get("bytes")
        good = done.get("status") == "done" and done.get("encoder_speed") == speed
        ok = ok and good
        lines.append(f"{speed}: {done.get('status')}, echoed {done.get('encoder_speed')!r}, "
                     f"{done.get('bytes')} bytes, {time.monotonic() - started:.1f} s")
    # Pairwise more than 1 % apart: SVT-AV1's threads make two encodes of one
    # project at one speed differ by a few bytes (A1 against A7's balanced, printed),
    # so "different" alone would pass with the speed ignored.
    values = [v or 0 for v in sizes.values()]
    distinct = len(values) == 3 and all(
        abs(a - b) > 0.01 * max(a, b) for i, a in enumerate(values) for b in values[i + 1:])
    noise = (abs(sizes["balanced"] - a1_bytes) if a1_bytes and sizes.get("balanced")
             else None)
    bad = refusal(doc, out / "a7-fast.mp4", preset="av1", encoder_speed="fast")
    other = refusal(doc, out / "a7-h264.mp4", preset="h264", encoder_speed="faster")
    left = [p.name for p in (out / "a7-fast.mp4", out / "a7-h264.mp4") if p.exists()]
    refused = (bad is not None and "encoder_speed" in bad and other is not None
               and "encoder_speed" in other and not left)
    check("A7", ok and distinct and refused,
          "; ".join(lines) + f"; sizes pairwise more than 1 % apart {distinct} (A1's balanced "
          f"encode of the same project differs from this one by {noise} bytes); "
          f"\"fast\" → {bad!r}; "
          f"h264 → {other!r}; files left {left}")


def row_a8(doc, out):
    box = out / "a8-box.mp4"
    hd = out / "a8-720p.mp4"
    detail, ok = "", False
    try:
        export(doc, box, preset="av1", size=[640, 480])
        export(doc, hd, preset="av1", size="720p")
        video = video_stream(box)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Codec export C1 fix pass (spec §11 CX-13): calibrate the `av1` row's CRF on the
owner's IMG_0018.MOV through Frame Job itself, since the spike's command-line
encodes of a decoded file do not transfer to the app's own frames.

crf_owner.py [--reuse]

Builds a Release copy of the tree (`tree_copy`, in `work/crf-owner-tree/`) whose
`SVTAV1Encoder` takes its CRF from the file `work/crf-owner/crf` when that holds a
number (an instrument only, never in the tree), launches it, makes the owner
clip's 1920 × 1080 30 fps project, exports `prores_422` (the reference, as
`av1_export_proof.py` R does), `hevc` at the five calibration rates, and `av1` at
each speed and CRF 12..30 step 2 with a cap of 50 Mb/s (so the cap never binds),
and scores each against the reference with ffmpeg's libvmaf. Appends to
`crf.jsonl` (`clip` "owner", `via` "app").
"""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

S = Path("/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-codecs/tools/proof/work/codec-spike")
PROOF = S.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROOF))
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROOF / "graphics_spike"))
import bounded  # noqa: E402
import mcp  # noqa: E402
import proof_app  # noqa: E402
import tree_copy  # noqa: E402

WORK = PROOF / "work" / "crf-owner"
TREE = PROOF / "work" / "crf-owner-tree"
CRF_FILE = WORK / "crf"
OWNER = PROOF / "media" / "owner-sync" / "IMG_0018.MOV"
LOG = S / "crf.jsonl"
RATES = {"low": 2_400_000, "medium": 3_600_000, "default": 4_354_560, "high": 4_800_000,
         "maximum": 7_200_000}
RELEASE = "a Debug build composes the 55 s clip too slowly to calibrate on"
ANCHOR = "        config.qp = Self.crf(speed: speed, bitsPerPixel: Double(cap)\n"
PATCH = ("        config.qp = (try? String(contentsOfFile: \"" + str(CRF_FILE) + "\", encoding: .utf8))"
         ".flatMap { UInt32($0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)) }"
         " ?? Self.crf(speed: speed, bitsPerPixel: Double(cap)\n")


def build():
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(TREE))
    if made is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"copy: {reason}")
    path = TREE / "app/Sources/ExportAV1Encoder.swift"
    text = path.read_text()
    assert text.count(ANCHOR) == 1, "anchor"
    path.write_text(text.replace(ANCHOR, PATCH))
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(TREE, 1800, release_only=RELEASE)
    if app is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"build: {reason}")
    return app


def vmaf(distorted, reference, tag):
    log = WORK / f"{tag}.vmaf.json"
    lavfi = ("[0:v]format=yuv420p,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[d];[1:v]format=yuv420p,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[r];"
             f"[d][r]libvmaf=log_fmt=json:log_path={log}:n_threads=12")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", str(distorted), "-i",
                    str(reference), "-lavfi", lavfi, "-f", "null", "-"], check=True)
    return round(json.loads(log.read_text())["pooled_metrics"]["vmaf"]["mean"], 3)


def rate_of(path):
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",
                          "stream=bit_rate", "-of", "csv=p=0", str(path)],
                         capture_output=True, text=True)
    return int(ran.stdout.strip() or 0)


def record(row):
    with open(LOG, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)


def main():
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    CRF_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    app = proof_app.bundle(str(TREE), RELEASE) if "--reuse" in sys.argv else build()
    launched = mcp.launch(str(proof_app.executable(app)), [], env=bounded.child_env({}),
                          log_path=str(WORK / "instance.log"), timeout=900)
    client = launched.client
    project = str(WORK / "owner.framejob")
    call = lambda tool, **a: client.call_with(tool, {"project": project, **a})
    try:
        client.call("new_project", path=project)
        media = call("import_media", path=str(OWNER))["media"]
        call("add_clip", track=call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][0]["id"], media=media,
             at=0)
        reference = WORK / "reference.mov"
        if not reference.exists():
            client.export_with({"project": project, "path": str(reference),
                                "preset": "prores_422"})
        for tier, bps in RATES.items():
            out = WORK / f"hevc-{tier}.mp4"
            out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            extra = {} if tier == "default" else {"video_bitrate": bps}
            client.export_with({"project": project, "path": str(out), "preset": "hevc", **extra})
            record({"kind": "hevc", "via": "app", "clip": "owner", "tier": tier,
                    "target_bps": bps, "actual_bps": rate_of(out),
                    "vmaf": vmaf(out, reference, f"hevc-{tier}")})
        for speed, preset in (("faster", 8), ("balanced", 6), ("smaller", 4)):
            for crf in range(12, 31, 2):
                CRF_FILE.write_text(str(crf))
                out = WORK / f"av1-{speed}-{crf}.mp4"
                out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                started = time.monotonic()
                client.export_with({"project": project, "path": str(out), "preset": "av1",
                                    "encoder_speed": speed, "video_bitrate": 50_000_000})
                record({"kind": "svt", "via": "app", "clip": "owner", "preset": preset,
                        "crf": crf, "cap_bps": None, "tier": None,
                        "wall_s": round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                        "actual_bps": rate_of(out), "vmaf": vmaf(out, reference,
                                                                  f"av1-{speed}-{crf}")})
                out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    finally:
        CRF_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        try:
            call("close_project", discard=True)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass
        launched.stop()
        mcp.remove_scratch(launched.socket_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

16	
17	* Z1 — every instance's log is silent: no `Frame Job: ` line (the parity check),
18	  no `Svt[` line (SVT's own banner, which CX-12 (6) routes away) and no

21	  clip is done; ffprobe reads video `av1` / `av01` / Main / `yuv420p` /

292	def boxes(data, start, end):
293	    at = start
294	    while at + 8 <= end:
295	        size, kind = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[at:at + 8])
296	        header = 8
297	        if size == 1:
298	            size, header = struct.unpack(">Q", data[at + 8:at + 16])[0], 16
299	        elif size == 0:
300	            size = end - at
301	        if size < header or at + size > end:
302	            return
303	        yield kind.decode("latin-1"), at + header, at + size
304	        at += size

311	
312	    def find(start, end, chain):
313	        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, start, end):
314	            if kind != chain[0]:
315	                continue
316	            if len(chain) == 1:
317	                return body, stop
318	            if kind == "stsd":
319	                body += 8            # version, flags, entry count
320	            found = find(body, stop, chain[1:])
321	            if found:
322	                return found
323	        return None
324	
325	    for _, trak, trak_end in [b for b in boxes(data, 0, len(data)) if b[0] == "moov"]:
326	        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, trak, trak_end):
327	            if kind != "trak":
328	                continue
329	            entry = find(body, stop, ["mdia", "minf", "stbl", "stsd", "av01"])
330	            if not entry:

333	            # + 8 resolution + 4 reserved + 2 frame count + 32 compressor + 2 depth + 2 -1.

336	                    p, t, m = struct.unpack(">HHH", data[cbody + 4:cbody + 10])
337	                    return ("nclx", p, t, m, data[cbody + 10] >> 7)
338	            return None

487	def row_a6(instance, out):
488	    path = out / "a6.mp4"
489	    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
490	    detail = ""
491	    ok = False
492	    doc = None
493	    try:
494	        doc = Doc(instance, "a6", 1920, 1080)
495	        media = doc.media(AV)
496	        track = doc.track()
497	        for k in range(24):
498	            doc.call("add_clip", track=track, media=media, at=k * 5 * SEC)
499	        clips = [c["id"] for c in doc.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"]]
500	        doc.call("set_video", clips=clips, patch={"scale": 3.0})
501	        length = doc.call("get_project")["project"]
502	        started = doc.client.call_with("export", {"project": doc.path, "path": str(path),
503	                                                  "preset": "av1", "encoder_speed": "balanced"})
504	        job = started["export_id"]
505	        # The export measures its sound first (the "Measuring loudness…" phase, whose
506	        # progress is the bar's first share, and the bar is put at that share's end when
507	        # the writer starts); the cancel must land while SVT-AV1 encodes, so it waits for
508	        # the phase to end and then for the bar to move past where the writer started it.
509	        progress, status, measured, floor = 0, {}, None, None
510	        deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
511	        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
512	            status = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
513	            progress = status.get("progress") or 0
514	            if status.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
515	                break
516	            if status.get("phase"):
517	                measured = max(measured or 0, progress)
518	            elif status.get("status") == "running" and measured is not None:
519	                if floor is None:
520	                    floor = progress
521	                elif progress > floor:
522	                    break
523	            time.sleep(0.05)
524	        if status.get("status") != "running":
525	            detail = f"never running past the measurement with progress above it: {status}"
526	        else:
527	            asked = time.monotonic()
528	            doc.client.call("cancel_export", export_id=job)
529	            final = {}
530	            while time.monotonic() - asked < 600:
531	                final = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
532	                if final.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
533	                    break
534	                time.sleep(0.05)
535	            took = time.monotonic() - asked
536	            exists = path.exists()
537	            ok = final.get("status") == "cancelled" and took <= CANCEL_BOUND and not exists
538	            detail = (f"cancelled while encoding, at progress {progress:.4f} (the measurement "
539	                      f"ended at {measured}, the writer started at {floor}); status {final.get('status')!r} "
540	                      f"{took:.2f} s after cancel_export (≤ {CANCEL_BOUND}); a file at the "
541	                      f"path: {exists}; the project {len(clips)} clips, "
542	                      f"{length['canvas']['width']} × {length['canvas']['height']}")
543	    except (mcp.ToolError, KeyError) as error:
544	        detail = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
545	    finally:
546	        if doc is not None:
547	            doc.close()
548	    check("A6", ok, detail)

658	def popup_darkest(png, views, scale, popup):
659	    """The darkest luma inside `popup`'s frame in the capture, through ffmpeg."""
660	    ran = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "stream=width,height",
661	                          "-of", "csv=p=0", str(png)], capture_output=True, text=True)
662	    width, height = (int(x) for x in ran.stdout.strip().split(",")[:2])
663	    raw = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(png), "-f", "rawvideo",
664	                          "-pix_fmt", "gray", "-"], capture_output=True).stdout
665	    x0, y0, w, h = (round(c * scale) for c in popup["frame"])
666	    pixels = [raw[y * width + x] for y in range(max(0, y0), min(height, y0 + h))
667	              for x in range(max(0, x0), min(width, x0 + w))]
668	    return min(pixels) if pixels else None

743	def vmaf(distorted, reference, log):
744	    """libvmaf's pooled mean of `distorted` against `reference`, both as 8-bit 4:2:0
745	    (ffmpeg's libvmaf filter, as the spike scored); None when it cannot run."""
746	    lavfi = ("[0:v]format=yuv420p,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[d];[1:v]format=yuv420p,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[r];"
747	             f"[d][r]libvmaf=log_fmt=json:log_path={log}:n_threads=12")
748	    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", distorted, "-i", reference,
749	               "-lavfi", lavfi, "-f", "null", "-"], 1200)
750	    try:
751	        return json.loads(Path(log).read_text())["pooled_metrics"]["vmaf"]["mean"]
752	    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
753	        print(f"  libvmaf failed (rc {ran['rc']}): {ran['stderr'][-300:]}", flush=True)
754	        return None

837	    dest = WORK / "mutant"
838	    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(dest))

840	    if made is None:

842	    copy = Path(made)
843	    anchors = MUTANTS[name]["anchors"]
844	    if any(path.startswith("core/") for path, _, _ in anchors):
845	        from hevc_alpha_proof import own_core
846	        reason = own_core(copy)
847	        if reason:
848	            return None, reason
849	        try:
850	            (copy / "core/tests").symlink_to(ROOT / "core/tests")
851	        except OSError as error:
852	            return None, f"the copy's core/tests could not be linked: {error}"
853	    for path, anchor, replacement in anchors:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Road map "codec-export" C1 — the `av1` row: AV1 in MP4 through the bundled
SVT-AV1 (spec §11 CX-1, CX-2, CX-9, CX-10, CX-12, CX-13).

    python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py [--app debug|release|PATH] [--rate]
    python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py --mutant NAME

Launches its own instances of the chosen app (`proof_app.py`: `--app`, else
`RC_PROOF_APP`, else Debug; a build older than its inputs is refused) on scratch
sockets, works under `tools/proof/work/av1-export/`, closes every project it opens
with `discard: true` and stops each instance by its own PID. ffprobe and ffmpeg
(Homebrew, with libdav1d) only READ the files: this Mac has no AV1 decoder, so
nothing here imports or plays an AV1 file through Frame Job or AVFoundation.

Rows (`<ID> ok|FAIL — <detail>`, then `scores: n/m`; exit 0 iff all passed):

* Z1 — every instance's log is silent: no `Frame Job: ` line (the parity check),
  no `Svt[` line (SVT's own banner, which CX-12 (6) routes away) and no
  `SVT-AV1: ` line (a warning or error it passed on).
* A1 — `export {preset: av1}` of AV.mov (640 × 360, 30 fps, 5 s) under a text
  clip is done; ffprobe reads video `av1` / `av01` / Main / `yuv420p` /
  640 × 360 and audio `aac` / `mp4a`, and the video lasts 5.0 s ± one frame.
* A2 — the file's compatible brands include `av01`.
* A3a — the bitstream: `-bsf:v trace_headers`' every sequence header has
  `color_description_present_flag` 1, `color_primaries`, `transfer_characteristics`
  and `matrix_coefficients` 1/1/1 and `color_range` 0.
* A3b — the container: the `av01` sample entry's `colr` box, read from the MP4's
  own bytes (moov/trak/mdia/minf/stbl/stsd), is `nclx` 1/1/1 with full_range 0.
* A4 — `ffmpeg -v error` decodes the file with no error line, ffprobe's decoded
  frame count is the range's (150), and `trace_headers` shows no temporal
  delimiter OBU (type 2).
* A5 — A1's file: the first packet is a keyframe (K), the longest K-to-K gap is
  ≤ 2.0 s, the key count is ≤ ceil(duration / 2 s) + 1 with at least one packet
  that is not K, and through `trace_headers` every K packet's shown frame is a
  KEY_FRAME (`frame_type` 0 with `show_frame` 1) and no other packet's is, and
  no packet holds a hidden intra frame (`frame_type` 0 or 2 with `show_frame` 0:
  an open GOP's forward keyframe).
* A6 — a 1920 × 1080, 30 fps, 120 s project (AV.mov 24 times, filling the
  canvas) exported at Balanced, cancelled once its progress is above 0 while it
  encodes — after the loudness measurement's phase, whose progress is the bar's
  first share, so the cancel meets the encoder and not the measurement: the
  status reads `cancelled` within 10 s of `cancel_export`, and no file is at
  the path. (Uncancelled, its 3,600 frames take far longer than 10 s at
  SVT-AV1's ~41–148 fps at 1080p, `designs/codec-export.md`'s spike.)
* A7 — A1's project at each `encoder_speed` (faster, balanced, smaller): each
  done, its answer's `encoder_speed` the one asked, and the three files' sizes
  pairwise more than 1 % apart; `encoder_speed: "fast"` and `encoder_speed` on `h264`
  are each refused naming `encoder_speed`, and nothing is at either path.
* A8 — `size: [640, 480]` on the 640 × 360 canvas is 640 × 480 with the
  picture letterboxed (the top 56 rows' luma ≤ 20, the middle rows' mean above
  20, frame 0's Y plane); `size: "720p"` decodes at 1280 × 720.
* A9 — an in/out export of 1 s to 3 s holds 60 frames.
* S1 — an instance pinned with `screens.py`'s PINS, `-RCDevAppearance light`
  and `FrameJobExportChoice` `{"preset_id":"av1","encoder_speed":"smaller"}`:
  File ▸ Export… shows Format "AV1 (MP4)", the popup after "Speed:" reads
  "Smaller file" and is drawn enabled, and the footnote is
  "AV1 · MP4 · Smaller file".
* S2 — the same pinned to `{"preset_id":"h264"}`: the Speed popup is drawn
  disabled. "Drawn enabled / disabled": the layout dump carries no enabled
  flag, so the popup's darkest pixel is compared with the Format popup's in
  the same light capture — within 40 levels is enabled, more than 60 lighter
  is disabled.
* R1, R2 — only with `--rate` (CX-13's soft-capped CRF): the owner's full-length
  clip `tools/proof/media/owner-sync/IMG_0018.MOV` (1920 × 1080, 30 fps,
  55.27 s) exported once as `prores_422` (the reference), then, R1 at "Format
  default" (no `video_bitrate`: the cap is HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel per
  frame) and R2 at the sheet's High tier (`video_bitrate` 0.129 × 0.6 to the
  nearest 100 kbps, asked of both), as `hevc` and as `av1` at each speed:
  each `av1` file's video bit rate (ffprobe, the whole file's average) is at
  most 1.25 × the cap (CX-13's soft cap) and its VMAF against the reference
  (ffmpeg's libvmaf, both as 8-bit 4:2:0) is at or above the `hevc` file's.
  Prints each rate, its share of the cap, each VMAF and each encode's frames
  per second. A missing fixture skips R by name; a libvmaf that cannot run is
  a FAIL.

`--mutant NAME` builds a copy of the tree (`tree_copy.make_copy`; `core/` made
the copy's own for a core mutant, `hevc_alpha_proof.own_core`) with each of the
mutant's anchors replaced (each found exactly once), builds its app
(`tree_copy.build_app`), runs every row but R on it (and, for a core mutant,
its `cargo test` file in the copy's core), and exits 1 when exactly the named
rows fail (caught), 0 when none of them does (survived), 3 when they fail
with others beside them, and 2 when the control could not be performed (a
copy, an anchor, a build or a launch).

  td-kept                    the core's strip keeps every temporal delimiter:
                             A4 and `cargo test --test av1_mp4`
  brand-unpatched            the finished file is never branded: A2
  open-gop                   `SVT_AV1_FWDKF_REFRESH` (an open GOP): A5 (hidden
                             INTRA_ONLY frames, one key) and Z1 (SVT-AV1's warning
                             that it set hierarchical levels to 4 for it)
  speed-ignored              SVT's preset fixed at 6: A7
  encode-ignores-cancel      every `isStopping()` in `ExportEncodePump` removed: A6
  speed-on-any-row           the core takes `encoder_speed` on any row: A7 and
                             `cargo test --test export_av1`
  colour-untagged-bitstream  SVT's CICP left unset: A3a
  colour-untagged-container  the format description's colour extensions
                             dropped: A3b

An instrument that cannot run is a FAIL, never an exit.
"""

import argparse
import atexit
import json
import math
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "graphics_spike"))
import bounded  # noqa: E402
import mcp  # noqa: E402
import proof_app  # noqa: E402
import tree_copy  # noqa: E402

WORK = HERE / "work" / "av1-export"
AV = HERE / "media" / "AV.mov"
OWNER = HERE / "media" / "owner-sync" / "IMG_0018.MOV"
SEC = 600_000
FRAMES = 150                     # AV.mov's 5 s at 30 fps
CANCEL_BOUND = 10.0
CAP_TOLERANCE = 1.30             # CX-13 (1): a soft cap; hard footage measured up to 1.254 ×

ROWS = ["Z1", "A1", "A2", "A3a", "A3b", "A4", "A5", "A6", "A7", "A8", "A9", "S1", "S2"]

SOURCES = "app/Sources"
MUTANTS = {
    "td-kept": {"rows": ["A4"], "cargo": "av1_mp4", "anchors": [
        ("core/src/av1_mp4.rs", "        if obu.kind != OBU_TEMPORAL_DELIMITER {\n",
         "        if obu.kind != OBU_TEMPORAL_DELIMITER || obu.kind == OBU_TEMPORAL_DELIMITER {\n")]},
    "brand-unpatched": {"rows": ["A2"], "anchors": [
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExporterWriter.swift", "                try ExportAV1Track.brandFile(destination)\n",
         "                _ = destination\n")]},
    "open-gop": {"rows": ["A5", "Z1"], "anchors": [
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExportAV1Encoder.swift", "        config.intra_refresh_type = SVT_AV1_KF_REFRESH\n",
         "        config.intra_refresh_type = SVT_AV1_FWDKF_REFRESH\n")]},
    "speed-ignored": {"rows": ["A7"], "anchors": [
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExportAV1Encoder.swift", "        config.enc_mode = speed.svtPreset\n",
         "        config.enc_mode = 6\n")]},
    "encode-ignores-cancel": {"rows": ["A6"], "anchors": [
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExportEncodePump.swift", "                guard !isStopping() else { return finish(false) }\n",
         "                guard !false else { return finish(false) }\n"),
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExportEncodePump.swift",
         "        guard !finished, !encoderFailed, !isStopping(), let encoder else { return }\n",
         "        guard !finished, !encoderFailed, let encoder else { return }\n"),
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExportEncodePump.swift", "            guard !isStopping() else { return false }\n",
         "            guard !false else { return false }\n")]},
    "speed-on-any-row": {"rows": ["A7"], "cargo": "export_av1", "anchors": [
        ("core/src/export.rs",
         "        let speed = match (encoder_speed(overrides)?, preset.takes_encoder_speed()) {\n",
         "        let speed = match (encoder_speed(overrides)?, true) {\n")]},
    "colour-untagged-bitstream": {"rows": ["A3a"], "anchors": [
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExportAV1Encoder.swift",
         "        config.color_primaries = EB_CICP_CP_BT_709\n"
         "        config.transfer_characteristics = EB_CICP_TC_BT_709\n"
         "        config.matrix_coefficients = EB_CICP_MC_BT_709\n", "")]},
    "colour-untagged-container": {"rows": ["A3b"], "anchors": [
        (f"{SOURCES}/ExportAV1Track.swift",
         "            kCMFormatDescriptionExtension_ColorPrimaries as String:\n"
         "                kCMFormatDescriptionColorPrimaries_ITU_R_709_2,\n"
         "            kCMFormatDescriptionExtension_TransferFunction as String:\n"
         "                REDACTED,\n"
         "            kCMFormatDescriptionExtension_YCbCrMatrix as String:\n"
         "                REDACTED,\n"
         "            kCMFormatDescriptionExtension_FullRangeVideo as String: false,\n", "")]},
}

results = {}


def check(ident, ok, detail):
    results[ident] = bool(ok)
    print(f"{ident} {'ok' if ok else 'FAIL'} — {detail}", flush=True)


# ---- reading the files (ffprobe, ffmpeg, the MP4's bytes) ------------------------

def run(argv, seconds=600):
    return bounded.run([str(a) for a in argv], seconds)


def streams(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries",
               "stream=codec_type,codec_name,codec_tag_string,profile,pix_fmt,width,height,"
               "duration,bit_rate,nb_frames,time_base", "-of", "json", path])
    return json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}").get("streams", [])


def video_stream(path):
    return next((s for s in streams(path) if s.get("codec_type") == "video"), {})


def brands(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format_tags=compatible_brands",
               "-of", "json", path])
    return (json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}").get("format", {}).get("tags", {})
            .get("compatible_brands", ""))


def decoded_frames(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
               "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "csv=p=0", path])
    try:
        return int(ran["stdout"].strip().split(",")[0])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def decode_errors(path):
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", path, "-f", "null", "-"])
    return ran["rc"], [line for line in ran["stderr"].splitlines() if line.strip()]


def packets(path):
    """ffprobe's video packets: [(pts seconds, key)]."""
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",
               "packet=pts_time,flags", "-of", "csv=p=0", path])
    out = []
    for line in ran["stdout"].splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split(",")
        if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] not in ("", "N/A"):
            out.append((float(parts[0]), "K" in parts[1]))
    return out


def trace(path):
    """`trace_headers` over the video: (header fields before the first packet,
    [{"key": bool, "fields": [(name, value)]}] per packet)."""
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "trace", "-i", path, "-map", "0:v:0", "-c",
               "copy", "-bsf:v", "trace_headers", "-f", "null", "-"])
    head, out = [], []
    for line in ran["stderr"].splitlines():
        if "[trace_headers" not in line or "] " not in line:
            continue
        body = line.split("] ", 1)[1]
        started = re.match(r"Packet: \d+ bytes, (key frame, )?pts", body)
        if started:
            out.append({"key": bool(started.group(1)), "fields": []})
            continue
        field = re.match(r"\d+\s+(\S+)\s+[01]+ = (-?\d+)$", body.strip())
        if field:
            (out[-1]["fields"] if out else head).append((field.group(1), int(field.group(2))))
    return head, out


def shows_key(fields):
    """Whether a packet's shown frame is a KEY_FRAME: a frame header with
    `frame_type` 0 and `show_frame` 1."""
    frame_type = None
    for name, value in fields:
        if name == "show_existing_frame":
            frame_type = None
        elif name == "frame_type":
            frame_type = value
        elif name == "show_frame" and value == 1 and frame_type == 0:
            return True
    return False


def hidden_intra(fields):
    """Whether a packet holds an intra frame that is not shown — a KEY_FRAME or an
    INTRA_ONLY frame (`frame_type` 0 or 2) with `show_frame` 0, shown later by
    `show_existing_frame`: an open GOP's forward keyframe, which SVT-AV1 v4.2.0
    writes as a hidden INTRA_ONLY frame."""
    frame_type = None
    for name, value in fields:
        if name == "show_existing_frame":
            frame_type = None
        elif name == "frame_type":
            frame_type = value
        elif name == "show_frame" and value == 0 and frame_type in (0, 2):
            return True
    return False


def y_plane(path, width, height, index=0):
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-vf",
                          f"select=eq(n\\,{index})", "-frames:v", "1", "-f", "rawvideo",
                          "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-"], capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    data = ran.stdout
    return data[:width * height] if len(data) >= width * height else None


def boxes(data, start, end):
    at = start
    while at + 8 <= end:
        size, kind = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[at:at + 8])
        header = 8
        if size == 1:
            size, header = struct.unpack(">Q", data[at + 8:at + 16])[0], 16
        elif size == 0:
            size = end - at
        if size < header or at + size > end:
            return
        yield kind.decode("latin-1"), at + header, at + size
        at += size


def colr_of(path):
    """The `av01` sample entry's `colr` box: (type, primaries, transfer, matrix,
    full_range) or None, read from the file's bytes."""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()

    def find(start, end, chain):
        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, start, end):
            if kind != chain[0]:
                continue
            if len(chain) == 1:
                return body, stop
            if kind == "stsd":
                body += 8            # version, flags, entry count
            found = find(body, stop, chain[1:])
            if found:
                return found
        return None

    for _, trak, trak_end in [b for b in boxes(data, 0, len(data)) if b[0] == "moov"]:
        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, trak, trak_end):
            if kind != "trak":
                continue
            entry = find(body, stop, ["mdia", "minf", "stbl", "stsd", "av01"])
            if not entry:
                continue
            # VisualSampleEntry: 6 reserved + 2 index + 16 pre_defined/reserved + 4 size
            # + 8 resolution + 4 reserved + 2 frame count + 32 compressor + 2 depth + 2 -1.
            for child, cbody, cstop in boxes(data, entry[0] + 78, entry[1]):
                if child == "colr" and data[cbody:cbody + 4] == b"nclx":
                    p, t, m = struct.unpack(">HHH", data[cbody + 4:cbody + 10])
                    return ("nclx", p, t, m, data[cbody + 10] >> 7)
            return None
    return None


# ---- the instance ----------------------------------------------------------------

class Instance:
    def __init__(self, label, app, arguments=(), env=None, home=False):
        self.label = label
        self.dir = WORK / label
        tree_copy.remove_tree(str(self.dir))
        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.log = self.dir / "instance.log"
        if home:
            (self.dir / "home").mkdir()
            env = {**(env or {}), "CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(self.dir / "home")}
        self.launched = mcp.launch(str(proof_app.executable(app)), list(arguments),
                                   env=bounded.child_env(env or {}), log_path=str(self.log),
                                   timeout=900)
        self.client = self.launched.client

    def stop(self):
        self.launched.stop()
        mcp.remove_scratch(self.launched.socket_path)

    def complaints(self):
        try:
            lines = self.log.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
        except OSError:
            return ["the log could not be read"]
        return [line.strip() for line in lines
                if "Frame Job: " in line or "Svt[" in line or "SVT-AV1: " in line]


class Doc:
    def __init__(self, instance, name, width=640, height=360):
        self.client = instance.client
        self.path = str(instance.dir / f"{name}.framejob")
        self.client.call("new_project", path=self.path)
        try:
            self.call("set_canvas", width=width, height=height, fps=30)
        except mcp.ToolError as error:
            if "made no change" not in str(error):    # a new project is 1920 × 1080 at 30
                raise

    def call(self, tool, **arguments):
        return self.client.call_with(tool, {"project": self.path, **arguments})

    def track(self):
        return self.call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][0]["id"]

    def media(self, path):
        return self.call("import_media", path=str(path))["media"]

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.call("close_project", discard=True)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass


def av_doc(instance, name):
    """AV.mov from 0 under a two-second text clip on a track of its own."""
    doc = Doc(instance, name)
    media = doc.media(AV)
    doc.call("add_clip", track=doc.track(), media=media, at=0)
    doc.call("add_track", name="Titles")
    titles = doc.call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][-1]["id"]
    doc.call("add_text_clip", track=titles, at=0, duration=2 * SEC, text={"content": "AV1"})
    return doc


def export(doc, path, **arguments):
    Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return doc.client.export_with({"project": doc.path, "path": str(path), **arguments})


def refusal(doc, path, **arguments):
    Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    try:
        answer = doc.client.call_with("export", {"project": doc.path, "path": str(path),
                                                 **arguments})
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        return str(error)
    if isinstance(answer, dict) and "export_id" in answer:
        try:
            doc.client.wait_export(answer["export_id"], seconds=300)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass
    return None


# ---- the rows --------------------------------------------------------------------

def rows_a1_a5(doc, out):
    a1 = out / "a1.mp4"
    try:
        done = export(doc, a1, preset="av1")
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        for ident in ("A1", "A2", "A3a", "A3b", "A4", "A5"):
